propositions: The misfire guard list in docs/local-dev-env.md is incomplete, missing the third member of the guard family: pytest_sessionfinish's session-level working-tree backstop.

The pytest_sessionfinish backstop diffes git status across the whole session and misfires on concurrent commit, rebase, branch switch, or editor save, same as the two per-test guards but fires once at session end.
The session-level backstop reports a REPO ISOLATION FAILURE at session tail rather than blaming an arbitrary straddling test like the per-test guards do.
Documentation must name pytest_sessionfinish alongside _no_repo_root_leaks and _no_repo_commits in the concurrent-writer misfire list.
The phrasing 'Both fire in teardown' must be updated to 'The two per-test guards' to reflect accuracy after adding the third bullet.
